plain_text:
Once the check is complete, all initial errors and warnings for that section will be displayed at
the bottom of the page. Validation errors are in red and must be resolved in order to submit
the APR. Warnings are in brown and provide information on a potential data issue, but do not
need to be resolved in order to submit the APR. As data are entered and errors and warnings
are resolved, the page will continue to check the validation status and remove an error or
warning if resolved.
semantic_text: Once the check is complete, all initial errors and warnings for that section will be displayed at the bottom of the page. Warnings are in brown and provide information on a potential data issue, but do not need to be resolved in order to submit the APR. As data are entered and errors and warnings are resolved, the page will continue to check the validation status and remove an error or warning if resolved.

plain_text:
In addition to the initial validation rules that run on each page, additional rules will run once
data are entered. All rules are available in the GEER Business Rules Guide located on the
Grantee Help Page. Every rule in the GEER Business Rules Guide, whether it is an Error or
Warning, will be listed along with its location on the Data Collection Tool, the Definition,
Resolution, Additional Information, and Logic used. Please reference this document with any
questions related to errors and warnings.

plain_text:
Because the templates contain multiple header rows (rows 1-6) that should not be edited,
being able to sort and filter grantee-entered data based on row 6 will be useful. To do so,
highlight all of row 6 and click the Filter icon (see fig. 24).
